title: Medicare and Medicaid Third Party Liability Act
short_title: Medicare and Medicaid Third Party Liability Act

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S7784-7785)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

summaries.text: Medicare and Medicaid Third Party Liability Act - Authorizes the Attorney General to seek a class action recovery from tobacco product manufacturers of any payments made under the Medicare, Medicaid, veterans' health care, or any other similar Federal health care program to or on behalf of more than one recipient with a disease, illness, condition, or complication caused, in whole or in part, by the use of tobacco products.
